items.item_text: Bachelors degree in a field relevant to clinical laboratory science which includes 6 semester hours (9 quarter hours) of chemistry and 6 semester hours (9 quarter hours) of biology or microbiology OR

Associates degree at least 60 semester hours (90 quarter hours) including 6 semester hours (9 quarter hours) of chemistry and 6 semester hours (9 quarter hours) of biology or microbiology, and five years full-time acceptable clinical laboratory experience in OR
HS Diploma and ten years full-time acceptable clinical laboratory experience in Chemistry, Hematology, Microbiology or Immunology within the last 15 years and demonstration of competency.
Experience working with computers and automated laboratory instrumentation.
Perform specimen collection and processing, including venipuncture and blood cultures, ensuring accurate identification and handling.
Operate and maintain automated laboratory equipment and information systems to provide consistent and reliable test results.
Monitor quality control and analyze pre-analytical factors to ensure all procedures meet strict regulatory standards.
Communicate effectively with supervisors and cross-shift team members to ensure the continuity of patient care.
Train new staff members, serve as a technical resource, and manage department inventory and supplies with a focus on cost-saving.
Resolve technical problems as they arise and strictly adhere to all hospital safety, ethical, and confidentiality policies.
